text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Sirius-senpai, just a salad? Don't 
you usually eat steak to build muscle...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not that hungry. Just shut up and 
eat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, sir! Well then, excuse me, down the 
hatch……!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Hah... Giving up meat because of rough 
skin... This is what poor self-management 
gets you... Pathetic.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Troubled by skin breakouts, Sirius Symboli 
had to cut back on her favorite foods...
